label: Isla Monarch
summary: A private island casino for the very rich, with the best security money can buy and a vault worth robbing.

world.setting: The Monarch, a casino resort on a private island in a warm sea
world.description: The Monarch only takes guests by invitation: billionaires, royalty and people whose money has no name. Its vault holds what they cannot keep anywhere else, its security chief has never lost a guest's property, and its owner, Augustin Roche, likes to say the house always wins. Tonight a crew is going to test that.
rules: Heists run on planning, nerve and improvisation when the plan breaks
Security is excellent; nothing works the easy way
Everyone on the crew has a reason to be here they have not told the others

narration.tone: Slick and tense, with banter and twists
